record.reference: Visceral signaling of post-ingestive malaise directs memory updating in Drosophila
record.title: Visceral signaling of post-ingestive malaise directs memory updating in Drosophila
record.identity_check: Full text retrieved from Europe PMC (PPR1106376) contains DOI 10.1101/2025.10.21.683769, the title line 'Visceral signaling of post-ingestive malaise directs memory updating in Drosophila' (normalized equality), and the surnames Senapati/Treiber/Waddell; all three identity criteria pass.
record.mapping_note: term_type PAPER_TERM: the full text uses the mechanism words mapped here - delayed post-ingestive reinforcement/cancellation (K5), the approach-to-relative-avoidance switch (K7), and serotonergic suppression plus safety memory (K10). Our contribution is only the family labels and the CONFIRMED/REVISED comparison.
record.description_scope: Action judged under the description 'the fly approaches or avoids the trained odor at test'. Because one training protocol produces approach to one odor and avoidance of the other, the D-axis can only be read per odor; the record-level class is therefore the condition-split (02 2.1-1).
record.motion_source: L3/L1 - visceral (gut) malaise signal after toxin-tainted sugar, acting through fat-body releasing modSP and Turandot A onto autocrine Toll signalling in the same dopaminergic neurons that formed and consolidate the sugar memory.

mechanism.claim: Delayed post-ingestive reinforcement is credited back to earlier odor memories by updating them during the consolidation window: the sugar reward memory for the toxin-paired odor is cancelled by the delayed post-ingestive aversive reinforcement while the memory is still labile.
mechanism.quote: This SA memory timeline is consistent with flies forming a sugar reward memory that is cancelled by delayed post-ingestive aversive reinforcement.
mechanism.note: The full text supports the credit-assignment/updating mechanism and its consolidation-window timing. The abstract's phrase 'turns approach into avoidance' is not counted as part of K5 here; the full text's behavioural qualification of that phrase is recorded under K7's REVISED difference.

mechanism.claim: The same training first produces conditioned approach and later a relative avoidance of the food-paired odor. The full text reports a rapid decline within 120 min followed by conversion to avoidance by 6 h, and attributes the 24 h choice to a parallel safety memory for the non-food odor rather than to an absolute aversive memory of CS+.
mechanism.quote: In contrast, SA trained flies initially showed strong approach to the previously food-paired odor which rapidly declined within the first 120 min after training and converted to avoidance by 6 h that persisted for at least 24 h.
mechanism.supporting_quote: 24 h after training behavior appears to be solely directed by a safety memory for the non-food paired odor – no CS+ approach or avoidance was evident at this time.
mechanism.difference: L-01 describes a discrete phase-reversed switch, explicitly 'not a gradual decline', whose direction is an absolute switch of the CS+ response to avoidance. The full text reports a rapid decline of CS+ approach within the first 120 min and conversion to avoidance by 6 h in the CS+ vs CS- choice, but a CS+ vs novel-odor test shows no preference by 2 h, and the 24 h behaviour is attributed to a safety memory for CS-: 'no CS+ approach or avoidance was evident at this time'. The approach-to-relative-avoidance direction and the consolidation-window dependence are retained; the temporal shape and the scope of the avoidance differ.

mechanism.claim: The malaise signal suppresses consolidation of the initial odor-sugar memory and forms a parallel safety memory for the odor experienced without food, through serotonergic modulation of distinct dopaminergic subtypes. Full text: DPM output 15-30 min after training is required for both the suppression and the CS- approach memory.
mechanism.quote: The DPM blocking experiments therefore demonstrate that 15-30 min after training is a critical time for malaise information to both suppress sugar-rewarded CS+ approach memory and form a CS- approach memory.
mechanism.note: The full text also identifies the receptor/Toll combinations in specific DAN subtypes; that detail is carried as an ADDITIONAL K10 entry and does not enter the core counts.

mechanism.claim: DPM-released 5-HT extends the effective inter-stimulus interval after feeding into the consolidation window, allowing post-ingestive reinforcement to be integrated.
mechanism.quote: Our work here suggests that DPM neuron released 5-HT can extend the effective ISI much further after a feeding event into the consolidation window so that post-ingestive reinforcement can be integrated.
mechanism.note: ADDITIONAL: supports the K5 family's timing claim but is not part of L-01's core set.

mechanism.claim: Specific 5-HT receptor and Toll combinations in PAM-γ3, PAM-β'2mp and PAM-γ5 DANs are required for the 24 h CS- approach memory.
mechanism.quote: Development of 24 h CS- approach required excitatory 5-HT7 receptors in PAM-γ3, 5-HT7 and Toll-6 in PAM-β'2mp, and inhibitory 5-HT1A and Toll-1 in PAM-γ5 DANs.
mechanism.note: ADDITIONAL: subtype-level support for K10, not part of L-01's core set.

record.event_grammar: [MOTION] ingestion of toxin-tainted sugar --> [GATE] visceral signals (modSP / Turandot A -> autocrine Toll in dopaminergic neurons) admit updating only during the consolidation window --> [INACTION/ACTION] avoidance of the paired odor, approach maintained to the unpaired 'safety' odor --> [OUTCOME] poisoned food not re-ingested, safe food still exploited --> [FEEDBACK] earlier odor memories rewritten retrospectively by the later visceral state

anchor_concordance.reason: Independent (insect) system, same committed family and sign: a delayed post-ingestive reinforcer is bound back onto the recently sampled cue and suppresses re-consumption - supporting the anchor's mechanism at the level of the credit-assignment problem, though by retrospective memory updating rather than reactivation-driven stabilization.

record.notes: Level FULLTEXT_REVIEWED: the normalized Europe PMC body is 116342 characters, above the registered floor of 21224. The preprint was posted 2025-10-22 and is not peer reviewed; the supplementary figures were not independently coded. The L-01 record is untouched: this is a new, parallel record. K7 is REVISED because the full text reports a rapid decline and a CS- safety-memory account rather than a discrete absolute switch to CS+ avoidance; K5 and K10 are CONFIRMED at the mechanism-family level.
record.layers_provenance: L01-D5: the protocol's §2 field list requires layers[], but the coding schema dropped it and l01_gate.py's field loop did not check it. Recovered by extracting exactly the L-tokens already present in motion_source, in first-mention order - no layer is invented here

differences.l01_claim: The behavioral output is a discrete phase-reversed switch, not a gradual decline: flies first express conditioned odor approach and only after consolidation does the same training switch the response to avoidance - a bistable, time-gated reversal whose direction depends on passing the consolidation window.
differences.fulltext_claim: The same training first produces conditioned approach and later a relative avoidance of the food-paired odor. The full text reports a rapid decline within 120 min followed by conversion to avoidance by 6 h, and attributes the 24 h choice to a parallel safety memory for the non-food odor rather than to an absolute aversive memory of CS+.
differences.difference: L-01 describes a discrete phase-reversed switch, explicitly 'not a gradual decline', whose direction is an absolute switch of the CS+ response to avoidance. The full text reports a rapid decline of CS+ approach within the first 120 min and conversion to avoidance by 6 h in the CS+ vs CS- choice, but a CS+ vs novel-odor test shows no preference by 2 h, and the 24 h behaviour is attributed to a safety memory for CS-: 'no CS+ approach or avoidance was evident at this time'. The approach-to-relative-avoidance direction and the consolidation-window dependence are retained; the temporal shape and the scope of the avoidance differ.
